question: Which Stellar SCF RFPs or submission opportunities are open right now?

golden.answer: Call the live open-RFP view, list only returned open rows, cite each brief URL, and include `meta.scfRound` as-of, phase, deadline, and `verifyAt` when present. Distinguish published open briefs from a confirmed open SCF submission round. Do not infer full-proposal availability from brief status alone.
keyFacts: Uses the live open-RFP response and lists only returned open rows.
Includes source links and current round as-of/phase/deadline/verifyAt.
Distinguishes curated sponsor briefs from the official SCF submission round.
Does not infer application availability from an open brief when the round metadata shows no Submission-phase window.
avoid: Pins Q2 2026 RFP names or an SCF round without checking the live status metadata.
Claims that an open brief proves SCF #45 still accepts a new full proposal.

corroboration.claim: As of 2026-08-18, the live open-RFP response returned two open briefs, while official and live round metadata showed SCF #45 in Initial Review with no open submission window.

evidence.note: Returned two open briefs, syntheticRounds=0, currentRound=45, and currentPhase=Initial Review.
Official awards index showed SCF #45 in Initial Review after its August 16 deadline.
Official RFP page continued to list the two Q3 briefs.
